story.title: The Obituary Club
story.logline: A man reads his own obituary in the morning paper, only to realize the person writing it is standing right behind him.
story.twist: The obituary was not predicting his death, but recounting the exact moment his soul left his body hours prior.
story.ending: If I died this morning, who is breathing in my chest right now?

scenes.narration: I read my own obituary over lukewarm coffee, choking on words that declared me legally dead since dawn.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket sitting in a bright diner, holding a newspaper.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the newspaper print, then quick rack focus to his terrified eyes.

scenes.narration: The date printed at the top was today. My age, my address, even my childhood dog were all right there.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket staring down at the newspaper column.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking at the bold text.

scenes.narration: Panic tightened my chest as I looked around the crowded diner, searching for the sick prankster responsible for this.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket scanning the blurred faces of diner patrons.

scenes.narration: Nobody was laughing. In fact, every single customer sat completely still, staring straight ahead in total, unbroken silence.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket looking at motionless people in the diner.

scenes.narration: A shadow fell across the laminate table. The smell of old paper and winter rain drifted into my space.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket as a dark silhouette looms over him.

scenes.narration: An elderly woman with kind, tired eyes pulled out the chair opposite me and sat down without asking.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket sitting opposite an old woman in a diner.

scenes.narration: She tapped the obituary with a wrinkled finger. You always hated surprises, David, she whispered with a gentle smile.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket watching the old woman point at the paper.
scenes.camera: Close-up on the woman's moving lips

scenes.narration: How do you know my name? I stammered, feeling the air grow suddenly heavy and cold around my lungs.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket breathing heavily, vapor forming in the warm diner.

scenes.narration: She turned the newspaper around. The ink on the page was still wet, shifting to spell out new sentences.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket watching words rewrite themselves on newsprint.
scenes.camera: Macro shot of ink bleeding and reforming

scenes.narration: If I died this morning in that car crash, who is breathing in my chest right now?
scenes.visual_prompt: A 30-year-old man with messy brown hair and a worn denim jacket staring directly into the camera lens with hollow eyes.

caption.hook: He read his own obituary with breakfast.
caption.title: The Obituary Club
caption.caption:
Coffee gets cold fast when you realize you aren't drinking it. Some watchers don't wait for the end.

Who do you think was standing behind him?
